Wi-Fi and mobile data disabled before first launch; no default Android network. Acknowledged Z8 setup information, prepared bundled minimal Debian 13.7, created a project, opened a usable shell and wrote/read an own source file without downloading tools. No external provider contract accepted.
type -P found no python3, git, node, codex or claude native executable before any optional installation. A Codex shell shim was present; this was not an installed Codex binary.

Required Python/pip/venv/CA package list was shown and metered opt-in remained unchecked. Operation completed naturally; UI reported 3.13.5-1 and actual python3 --version reported 3.13.5. A Python arithmetic assertion printed 42.
Back dismissed the keyboard. Home and explicit app return preserved the existing terminal, shell variable and own source marker.
An own manually started Python server bound to 127.0.0.1:8090 served a synthetic page through the actual app preview opened by xdg-open. No external page or account was used.

Actual Settings Cancel retained own seeded cookie/localStorage. Confirmed clear stopped the preview to a placeholder; explicitly reopening the same origin showed empty cookie/localStorage. Source marker, fixture hash and manually started server were preserved.

A second new project cloned from the included prepared base did not inherit the primary project source marker or optional Python installation. This was a new base project, not a copy of an existing user project.

One actual Close all and delete action stopped the disposable project live sleep child and removed its project/source, HOME and environment directories. The other primary project source hash and live manual server identity were preserved; no retry was needed.

Android Quick Settings > Active apps > z8 > Stop displayed Stopped. No processes remained for the app UID; the manual preview server was gone and the source marker hash was unchanged. Explicit relaunch showed zero open sessions and did not replay the command.

productionFindings.finding: Optional APT/Node/CLI paths still download native executables outside Play. Official policy restricts external executable delivery and has a VM/interpreter exception; the reviewed text does not conclusively classify this PRoot design.
productionFindings.action: Use the existing transparent local-terminal submission explanation, disclosing official downloads and actual execution. Preserve a contingency if Google rejects the stated architecture. Do not rename/hide native payloads or claim user initiation alone grants an exception.

productionFindings.finding: The shared service always starts with SPECIAL_USE, including independently initiated base preparation and selected-tool installation with no interactive terminal required. These finite jobs download, unpack, configure and verify files. Official Android guidance expressly assigns download/fetch/local-file processing to dataSync, whereas specialUse covers valid cases outside other types. This is a concrete scope mismatch to address, not merely an unspecified review question.
productionFindings.action: Give finite preparation/install work an appropriate dataSync or other suitable job lifecycle; retain specialUse for actual interactive terminal work. Select types by active work, handle timeout/stop and concurrent terminal preservation, and retest. Merely adding a manifest type or always enabling both is insufficient. Then prepare feature-specific descriptions and trigger videos.
productionFindings.limit: Engineering classification based on observed standalone paths, not a Google enforcement decision. User initiation and visible progress support general FGS eligibility but do not themselves justify specialUse. Interruption-safe package handling and user Stop must survive any change.

productionFindings.finding: The operator's ordinary Gmail/no-forwarding arrangement and90day retention are documented. The actual support-processing/overseas-transfer legal route, applicable recipient-country/timing/method/contact/refusal particulars and necessary controller/responsibility details remain unestablished. A Google US address is not proof of processing only in the US.
productionFindings.action: Document the arrangement and the applicable Korean legal basis, then publish the required particulars supported by that route. If consumer Gmail cannot supply them, assess a dedicated support provider with documented processing/storage/access terms. No automatic migration, forwarding or third-party inquiry is authorized by this finding.
productionFindings.limit: This is a concrete unresolved operational/legal assessment, not a finding that all direct user-provider requests are operator-controlled overseas transfers.

No additional missing source input was established here. Immutable source/notices still retain pending closure/review flags, so the project's promotion gate remains closed.
productionFindings.action: Finish a finite assessment of the combined-work source/delivery obligations against the published inputs and actual binary distribution arrangement. Retain precise upstream notices and the version-specific source link. If anything is missing, identify the specific input and build role; do not substitute an unlimited full-repository/full-machine demand or a reviewer name for evidence.
productionFindings.limit: No legal approval or closure flag granted. Reproducible byte identity for every permissive library and a lawyer's signature are not asserted as universal license conditions.

productionFindings.finding: Z8 remains a general-purpose local terminal with optional official clients, not its own model service. The current guidance does not expressly classify this exact architecture. If treated as an AI-generation feature, the policy's in-app reporting/moderation obligations become relevant; support-email handoff alone is not that workflow.
productionFindings.action: Keep review/listing claims aligned with the actual terminal/client boundary. Do not claim a confirmed exemption or invent a hosted AI product. If Google identifies an in-scope feature, implement the corresponding substantive safeguards or narrow that feature transparently.
productionFindings.limit: Conditional, not a new mandatory report-button code change established by this audit.
